rule_title: TTP 1003.002 - Mimikatz SAM Dump: Bulk SAM_USER Handle Burst via lsass.exe (EID 4661)
description: Detects Mimikatz lsadump::sam iterating all SAM user objects. The pattern is a high-volume burst of EID 4661 events with ObjectType SAM_USER, ObjectServer 'Security Account Manager', where ProcessName is lsass.exe acting on behalf of a non-machine SubjectUserName. Each SAM_USER access corresponds to one account's password hash being read. Normal SAM access involves 1-2 objects; Mimikatz accessing an entire domain produces 50+ SAM_USER events within seconds.
